name: Putting The Past Behind
overview: Scripture calls believers to release their hold on past failures and regrets, focusing instead on the new life given through Christ. Isaiah 43:18 exhorts us not to dwell on former things, while Luke 9:62 emphasizes the necessity of looking forward without turning back when committed to God's kingdom. Romans 8:1 assures that in Christ there is no condemnation for those who walk by the Spirit, and Galatians 2:20 reveals that our identity is now rooted in Christ living within us. This transformative perspective enables believers to move beyond past burdens and faithfully serve the Lord, as exemplified by Peter's restoration in John 21:15.
